_doc: C2 default configuration (EXP-2026-003). PHY/antenna defaults follow the 3GPP calibration example's DenseA settings (cttc-nr-3gpp-calibration.cc) except ISD (500 m, fixed by the design) and shadowing (off, see enable_shadowing). Traffic rates and targets are placeholders for the pilot to recalibrate.

scenario.name: UMa
scenario._notes: Fading = TR 38.901 ThreeGpp spectrum model; it is also what applies the sector antenna pattern in 5G-LENA, so it cannot be turned off in the 21-cell layout without losing sectorisation. Shadowing is off because ThreeGppPropagationLossModel draws a new shadowing sample on every pathloss evaluation, whose count depends on scheduled transmissions (would break C-4). Reuse-1 on one carrier (calibrationConf NR sets freqScenario=1, overlapping). TDD pattern DDDSU instead of the calibration default all-F: with F slots 5G-LENA v5.1 aborts (nr-spectrum-phy.cc:1244 'gNB transmission overlaps in time with UE transmission') when a UE, after HandoverStart has switched its PHY to the target cell, still sends a UL data TB granted by the source cell while the target gNB is transmitting DL in the same F slot. With DL/UL slots common to all cells, such a stale TB lands in a UL slot where every gNB receives.

ues._notes: Drop: HexagonalGridScenarioHelper sector mode (uniform in a disc of radius R*sqrt(3)/2 - min_bs_ut_distance around each sector-hexagon centre, R = ISD/3), UE i in cell (i mod 21)+1. Mobility: ns3::RandomDirection2dMobilityModel, Pause 0, Bounds = the helper's layout box (site extent +/- ISD), written to streams.json. handover_joining_timeout_ms = 500 (LENA default 200, set equal to LENA's HandoverLeavingTimeoutDuration default 500): when the handover command is delayed at the source for more than the joining timeout, the target drops the context but the UE still completes the handover (UE-side HandoverEndOk) and is left connected with no bearer at the target, receiving nothing for the rest of the run; probe runs: 6-9 of 105 UEs dead at 3-5 s with 200 ms, 0 and 2 with 500 ms (logs-c2/probe/E*). initial_attach = closest: AttachToMaxRsrpGnb aborted one of two probe runs ('Cannot TX while RX', nr-spectrum-phy.cc:838).

clusters._rule: Cell c belongs to site floor((c-1)/3); site 0 is the centre (azimuth 0), ring sites 1..6 sit at azimuth 30,90,150,210,270,330 deg at distance ISD. stadium = site 0. hospital_zone = the two ring sites east of the centre (azimuth 30 and 330, x > 0 and |y| < ISD). The remaining four ring sites split by the sign of y: north_cluster = y > 0 (azimuth 90, 150), south_cluster = y < 0 (azimuth 210, 270). all_cells = 1..21. Positions are written to cells.csv on every run.
